record.summary: The load-bearing shape of cold-bore: a fault-injectable scale model of a completions-style data platform (edge simulator, RabbitMQ data/control/ telemetry planes, Rust ingest, TimescaleDB, Python API/WebSocket egress, dashboard game console). Owns the architecture document and binds every component spec to the hop-by-hop delivery contract defined there.
record.title: System architecture and delivery contract
